Duke & Duke club canapés.d: Prunes stuffed with a whole almond, wrapped in thin bacon and baked until crisp. Served warm.
Duke & Duke club canapés.note: Passed in the Members’ Bar from five.

Frozen orange juice shots.note: Ask at the bar once the market closes.

Billy Ray's club dinner.note: From the carving cart every evening.
